name: ECHKIN_PHASE_INFO
description: The ECHECKIN_PHASE_INFO table contains information about the "just in time" eCheck-In status. Each row contains information about a single phase where eCheck-In information could be asked, such as pre-arrival or post-arrival.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for this contact. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: CM_CT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this contact. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: ECHKIN_PHASE_C_NAME
columns.description: A given phase for just-in-time eCheck-In, to track statuses of eCheck-In at a given point in time. When used with the rest of the items in the related group, this allows retrieving phase-based status information, such as whether a patient completed all of their pre-arrival or post-arrival tasks.

columns.name: ECHKIN_PHASE_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The status for a given phase of just-in-time eCheck-In. This tracks whether a patient completed all of their tasks for a given phase, such as pre-arrival or post-arrival.

columns.name: ECHKIN_URL_PHASE_YN
columns.description: Whether a URL was generated for eCheck-In during a given phase for just-in-time eCheck-In. This tracks whether a "for all" workflow was available, not whether a tickler was sent manually from front desk workflows.
